Interior Design · Brand Identity

Sana
Interiors

A complete identity reconstruction for a growing interior design studio — from a minimal Arabic wordmark to a refined, contemporary monogram with architectural depth.

Project Overview

From a personal signature to a complete visual identity built for scale.

Sana Interiors began with a simple Arabic logo that served the early stage of the brand. As the studio grew into a recognised name in residential and commercial interior design, the need for a stronger, more premium presence became clear.

The new identity was developed from the ground up — introducing a distinctive SI monogram, a refined custom logotype, and a full visual system grounded in the textures and materials of architectural space.

Semi-Luxury Neo-Classic Minimal Architectural Elegant Contemporary
The Icon

S meets I — a fluid architectural fusion.

The visual icon was developed by abstractly merging the initials S and I. Rather than a literal typographic mark, the letters were transformed into a fluid architectural form where curves and vertical structure interact to create a balanced symbol.

The vertical element represents structure and stability, while the flowing S-curve introduces movement and spatial harmony — reflecting the relationship between architecture and the interior space it contains.

Brand Atmosphere

Inspired by material.

The visual atmosphere of Sana Interiors is drawn from the natural architectural materials at the heart of interior design — leather, marble, wood, and concrete. These textures express warmth, depth, and authenticity while reinforcing the brand's semi-luxury, architectural character.

Warm neutrals drawn from the brand's material world — from Oxblood leather to alabaster marble, from raw concrete to walnut wood.
